text.p: Marshalltown Financial Corp said it has extended an agreement under which BancSecurity Corp will acquire Marshalltown.
In a statement, Marshalltown said it signed a forbearance agreement with BancSecurity which provides additional time for BancSecurity to seek Federal Reserve Board approval for the acquisition.

A definitive agreement the two companies signed last year expired September 30. Marshalltown executive vice president William Gross said in a telephone interview Monday that the new agreement extends the old agreement to December 13 if the Federal Reserve Board does not approve the merger.
If the board approved it, the agreement could be extended until January 15, Gross said.

Under the new agreement, if the transaction were consummated, Marshalltown shareholders would receive the original $24.7 million, which would increase at an annual interest rate of six percent from September 30 through the closing date.
If the transaction were not consummated, BancSecurity would pay Marshalltown $75,000 under the new agreement, Marshalltown said. The merger remains subject to regulatory review.
